replies.body_tagged: Stupid question, but whats the difference between KOTH and CTH?

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
In KOTH, there can be:
- More than one hill
- Enabled building
- Default ownership to a hill
- Decay of ownership
- Blitz (capture once, win)
- Default loadouts
- More nebula-oriented layout
